source_evidence: Player exact 'use knack' authorizes Psi-Bolstered Knack, not Commanding Presence or automatic commission acceptance. The original negotiation 22 fell short of the explicitly predeclared highest DC23; lower compensation was a fallback, so this targeted failed tier is treated as eligible failed proficient Persuasion check under campaign Knack rule. Rogue4 d6, actual visible Python secrets batch 547eb1445a34205ea187409016f0bf14 face2 =>24 success; spend exactly one Psi die,6→5/6. No reroll or Superiority spend. Apply predeclared improved offer1800gp including200gp signing advance credited against first500gp milestone, remaining300gp on that milestone and1300gp on second. No accepted signature or payment yet. D315~11:45 Caereth palace private council chamber, V/Elara/Mara/Cirren/Fenar with security councillor and secretary. V explicitly invoked Psi-Bolstered Knack on failed highest DC23 negotiation tier (lower fallback offer already available at original22). Genuine visible Python secrets d6 face2, total24 meets DC23, one Psi die spent6→5/6; Superiority4/4 unchanged. Crown revised offer maximum1800gp, 200gp payable on signing credited toward total, 500gp total first identification/corroboration milestone (300 additional after advance), 1300gp second authenticated sponsor/controller chain and usable intelligence milestone. No signature, advance, receipt, commission acceptance, letter transfer or travel yet. Written liaison credentials and access offered; no private-war authority or double payment for identical milestone. Orseld warning dated D306 received D313, rival colors/similar tactics, perpetrators and sponsor unconfirmed. Kestrel copying begun, no completed certified set or surrender. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi5/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 full slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; Mara/Elara/horses healthy. Rest5/6 safe-city sequence, food21/feed28, purse203gp4sp6cp, conditional240gp sale unpaid; all other custody unchanged. Guild Defense meeting late afternoon D315 still planned. V dice delegated until stop. Await acceptance or alternative.
